label: of rural women at work, 2025
source: MoSPI, National Statistics Office: Periodic Labour Force Survey, calendar year 2025 (January to December, new design). Rural women aged 15 and above who were at work (usual status; unpaid family work counts). Survey estimates; small states carry wider sampling error. Himachal Pradesh (66.3), Nagaland (65.6) and Meghalaya (64.1) are within 2.2 points of each other, and Ladakh (62.0) and Arunachal Pradesh (61.7) are level: read ranks two to five as a group.
hook_vo: Where are rural women most often at work?
map_vo: Every state, mapped. India: forty-five percent.
